Name: Improve Town A Little
Author: tikamin557
Description:
I created this for myself in time because my favorite Town map improvement mod is not yet compatible with SDV1.6.
If you are similarly inclined, or if you don't want to make major changes to the map, I can recommend it to you.

You can see where the modifications were made in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21740?tab=images]Image[/url].
Other changes include removing some disturbing pebbles from the town and a few stumps (which cannot be cut).
Almost all items can be turned on or off in detail from the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]ModConfig[/url]" settings.
The event map is also supported.
[color=#00ff00][size=4]Since it does not interfere with vanilla bushes, existing saved data can be installed without problems.[/size][/color]

[s]It is not compatible with other mods that significantly change the town map.
(Mods that drastically change the map itself, such as SVE, SVR3 etc.)
[/s]Since it is now possible to turn settings on and off in detail in ModConfig, these settings may work properly depending on where they are edited.

[color=#ffff00][size=1]Version 1.7~[/size][/color]
Added compatibility with
It is okay to have all ModConfig settings enabled.
However, the event map is currently not supported.

Version 2.1~

It is okay to have all ModConfig settings enabled.
However, the event map is currently not supported.

If you have any requests, please send them to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21740/?tab=posts]POSTS [/url]page.
